summary: This directory manages the core identity generation and schema definitions for order entities. It provides the foundational structure for creating unique order identifiers and serves as a central access point for shared order-related data models within the system.
responsibilities: Provision of consistent order identity and data structure interfaces
relationships: The order identifier generation logic relies on the underlying order schema definitions to ensure consistent entity identification.
designDecisions: Centralized export of schema definitions to ensure consistent usage across the domain
Encapsulation of identifier generation to maintain consistency in order creation
